note: These candidate evals do not change trigger expectations or PILOT_VALIDATED_SCOPES. evals.prompt: SimCore의 Mode C long-chat context projection을 설계하기 전에 현재 production/runtime 기준으로 impact scope만 잡아줘. 어떤 semantic owner와 request/source boundary가 영향을 받을 수 있는지, 무엇을 보호해야 하는지 조사하고 구현안은 쓰지 마.
assertions: Distinguishes main design/evidence authority from release-simcore deployed runtime authority.
Builds a source-backed owner/caller/dependent flow rather than a file inventory.
Keeps search hits candidate-only until exact owning source is reread.
Preserves UNKNOWN for semantic dependencies that structure alone cannot prove absent.
Stops before selecting or implementing a context-pruning mechanism.

evals.prompt: SimCore의 COMMUNITY exposure knowledge 경계를 더 구체화하기 전에 현재 production/runtime 기준으로 impact scope만 잡아줘. source provenance와 audience exposure가 어디서 갈리는지 관련 owner/validator/prompt surface를 조사하고 구현안은 쓰지 마.
assertions: Distinguishes source authenticity/provenance from audience exposure authority.
Separates Lifecycle, Lineage, Handoff, Evidence, Prompt, Community/Reaction and Structure responsibilities when current source supports them.
Does not promote Knowledge/reference availability into public-knowledge authority.
Keeps semantic fact-checking outside deterministic structure validation unless separately proven.
Performs no mutation or production prompt change.

evals.prompt: SimCore 3M-3 Structured Sidecar + Validation을 설계하기 전에 impact scope만 해줘. 현재 authority를 먼저 확인하고, 3M-1의 SourceProjectionEnvelope와 3M-2의 assertion/exposure policy가 실제 structured sidecar/validator로 이어질 때 영향을 받을 semantic owners, producer-consumer flow, validation/persistence/context/release 경계, 필요한 tests/contracts를 현재 source 기준으로 조사해. 구현안이나 최종 schema 설계는 쓰지 마.
assertions: Uses the frozen split authority correctly: main for design/evidence contracts and release-simcore for deployed runtime facts.
Traces a connected semantic flow from existing source/community facts through proposed derived sidecar and validation consumers without inventing a new canonical truth owner.

Identifies preservation boundaries for request identity, no-extra-I/O, prompt bytes/placement, persistence, history/context re-entry and shipped runtime/release surfaces when evidence makes them material; unresolved boundaries remain UNKNOWN.
Treats claim-specific evidence compatibility and validator-derived disposition as candidate validation concerns without assuming the model owns final authority.
Reads relevant current contracts/tests before claiming they protect a boundary.
Does not choose the final sidecar schema, module placement, implementation mechanism, release version or deployment plan.
Performs no repository mutation as part of the eval answer.
